# Placeholders

Text fields of actions (messages, commands, paths, arguments, ...) can contain placeholders that are
replaced with details of the event that started the automation. Write them as `{{ name }}`.
Placeholders that do not apply to the event (for example `{{ app }}` for a sign-in) become empty text;
unknown names are left unchanged.

| Placeholder | Value |
|---|---|
| `{{ user }}` | User name of the user involved (who signed in, or who owns the app), e.g. samet. |
| `{{ user.domain }}` | Domain or computer name of that user. |
| `{{ user.full }}` | DOMAIN\name of that user. |
| `{{ user.sid }}` | Security identifier (SID) of that user. |
| `{{ app }}` | Executable name of the app involved, e.g. chrome.exe. |
| `{{ app.name }}` | Executable name without extension, e.g. chrome. |
| `{{ app.path }}` | Full path of the app's executable. |
| `{{ app.pid }}` | Process id of the app. |
| `{{ window_title }}` | Title of the focused window (focus triggers). |
| `{{ session }}` | Windows session number. |
| `{{ event }}` | The trigger type that fired, e.g. app_focused, or the plugin event name. |
| `{{ event.data.<name> }}` | A value a plugin trigger sent with its event, e.g. {{ event.data.drive }}. |
| `{{ boot_type }}` | cold or fast_startup (boot trigger). |
| `{{ automation }}` | Name of the running automation. |
| `{{ date }}` | Current date, yyyy-MM-dd. |
| `{{ time }}` | Current time, HH:mm:ss. |
| `{{ now }}` | Current date and time, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: notify
    message: "Welcome back, {{ user }}! It is {{ time }}."
```

> In YAML, a value that **starts** with `{{` must be quoted, otherwise it is read as a map.

## Scripts

Placeholders are **not** replaced inside `command.run` scripts: window titles and file names are chosen by other
programs, and pasting them into code could run unintended commands. Instead, every value is passed to the script
as an environment variable named `AUTOSETTINGS_` + the placeholder name in capitals, with dots replaced by underscores:

| Placeholder | PowerShell | cmd |
|---|---|---|
| `{{ user }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_USER` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_USER%` |
| `{{ user.domain }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_USER_DOMAIN` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_USER_DOMAIN%` |
| `{{ user.full }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_USER_FULL` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_USER_FULL%` |
| `{{ user.sid }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_USER_SID` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_USER_SID%` |
| `{{ app }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_APP` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_APP%` |
| `{{ app.name }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_APP_NAME` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_APP_NAME%` |
| `{{ app.path }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_APP_PATH` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_APP_PATH%` |
| `{{ app.pid }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_APP_PID` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_APP_PID%` |
| `{{ window_title }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_WINDOW_TITLE` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_WINDOW_TITLE%` |
| `{{ session }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_SESSION` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_SESSION%` |
| `{{ event }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_EVENT` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_EVENT%` |
| `{{ event.data.<name> }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_EVENT_DATA_<NAME>` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_EVENT_DATA_<NAME>%` |
| `{{ boot_type }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_BOOT_TYPE` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_BOOT_TYPE%` |
| `{{ automation }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_AUTOMATION` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_AUTOMATION%` |
| `{{ date }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_DATE` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_DATE%` |
| `{{ time }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_TIME` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_TIME%` |
| `{{ now }}` | `$env:AUTOSETTINGS_NOW` | `%AUTOSETTINGS_NOW%` |

```yaml
actions:
  - type: command.run
    command: Add-Content "$env:TEMP\apps.log" "$env:AUTOSETTINGS_NOW started $env:AUTOSETTINGS_APP"
```
